title: Split FilterPresetAdmin into admin workflow modules
description: Refactor includes/Admin/FilterPresetAdmin.php into bounded admin modules without changing saved preset option shape or admin routes.
objective: Remove the 1487-line admin monolith before adding more preset preview, handoff, or Elementor-facing behavior.
expected_outputs: Preset list, form, save action, preview, and Elementor handoff modules
acceptance_criteria: Nonce, capability, escaping, and sanitization checks remain equivalent.
Each new admin module stays below the plugin line budget.
verification: php scripts/verify-line-budget.php --strict passes or reports only tracked transition debt.

budgets.context_budget: admin preset files and support preset storage

risks: Splitting save actions can weaken nonce or capability checks.
Moving render helpers can accidentally change admin form names.
Admin UI behavior can drift if preview and form rendering are split without characterization checks.
